dfg_edges.rationale: The configuration read is started by the schedule signal.

The keyword loop iterates over the routed keyword rows.
The competitor loop iterates over the routed competitor rows.
The AI agent summarizes the merged digest.
The formatter consumes the AI-generated report text.
The formatted row takes the Competitor/Keyword label and source links from the digest.
The report row is archived in the Report sheet.

notes: The frozen requirement declares a single Report sheet with columns Date, Competitor/Keyword, Summary, Link; the two native archive tabs (Report / Report02) were therefore collapsed into one declared outcome per path rather than treated as separate outcomes. Iteration nodes (n4, n9) model the per-target processing declared by 'For each target'; each terminates when its target list is exhausted and is bounded to at most 20 iterations per run. The two native If nodes carry identical field-presence conditions; they are modelled as one routing node per the requirement's type-based routing declaration. Requirement step (5) declares 'clean, format, and archive intelligence with source links': the deterministic row formatting is therefore modelled as separate code nodes (n14 keyword / n15 competitor) that consume the AI-generated report text (semantic -> code DFG edge), while the native Archive nodes provide evidence for both the formatting and the final append; the terminal nodes (n8, n13) keep the single archive contract.
